title: The Clock of No Time
description: A minigame-esque mod that adds the challenge of surviving periodic events during your playthrough.
body:
![The Clock of No Time - Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ede3a0e3245f3ebf6edcf61ce90d992124d8f7af.gif)
# **The Clock of No Time**

...is a mod based around the clock's challenge: Survive waves of events, whether they be beneficial or cataclysmic. The goal of this mod is to add a layer of difficulty to a survival playthrough and make getting to the end much more harder.

 

### How to play

Craft the clock itself by reforging a destroyed timepiece in a form of soul fire (which is obtained by blasting a regular clock).
...or enable the clock constantly within the mod's server-side config, wherein you can decide other variables within the challenge.
 

### Commands

Initiate Event - /tcontevent <player> <id>

 

### Event Index


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1 - Summon vexes around player.

2 - Summon a dragon fireball above player.

3 - Tax the player by taking 5 XP levels, saturation, and item in their mainhand.

4 - Lowers the gravity of the player temporarily.

5 - Restores player health.

6 - Doubles the player's size temporarily.

7 - Halves the player's size temporaily.

8 - Grants the player a blessing.

9 - Set the player on fire.

10 - Sends the player somewhere happy.

11 - Places a bomb in the player.

12 - Strikes the player with lightning.

13 - Spawns an angry iron golem on the player.

14 - Resets all players' spawn points to the target player's location.

15 - Deletes the region the player is in.

16 - Takes 8 items out of the player's inventory.

17 - Increases the player's gravity temporarily.

18 - Places a spikefall below the player.

19 - Places the player within a variant maze tower.

20 - Fills the player's inventory with poisonous potatoes.

21 - Teleports the player to the top of a stone pillar at world height.

22 - Turns the player into a vampire, blood sucking and all.

23 - Gives the player extreme speed and jump boost.

24 - Makes the player extremely sick.

25 - Invokes a cataclysm.

</details>
